record.summary: The dashboard grows the panel spec 030 deliberately left out: a per-project economics view over the served rollup, per-spec cost and rework beside run totals, every number carrying its denominator and every unknown shown as unknown. No new API surface and no new capability the CLI lacks: the panel renders exactly what /api/projects/<name>/economics already serves, under the same honesty rules the rest of the SPA lives by (029: never-loaded is null, an unreachable daemon is a named state, estimates say estimate).
record.title: Web UI: the economics panel
